advancements.doctor_m.root.title: DOCTOR M
advancements.doctor_m.root.description: Why is it called DOCTOR M? En... DOCTOR MOD, DOCTOR MC, anyway, it has multiple meanings~
advancements.doctor_m.enter_trenzalore.d: In a snow-covered town, an aged warrior is about to face his final hour, and his glorious old body is about to begin a new chapter.
advancements.doctor_m.obtain_time_key.de: We have the power to do whatever we want. Absolute control over every particle in the universe. Absolute control over everything that ever existed and everything that ever will. From now on, are you listening to me, Romana? Because if you aren't, I can make you listen, for I can do anything. From this moment on, there is no free will in the entire universe. Only my will, for I possess the Key to Time!
advancement.doctor_m.not_thermos.title: This really isn't a thermos...
advancement.doctor_m.not_thermos.descrip: What are you doing?? Drinking the oxygen from the tank??
advancement.doctor_m.you_ate_this.title: You ate that thing?!
advancement.doctor_m.you_ate_this.descri: In extreme hunger, one can become incredibly strong—like you, who pried open the oxygen tank valve with bare hands, gulped down the compressed air as if it were a biscuit, swallowing the tank and all. Your stomach protested, but your will prevailed.
advancement.doctor_m.deafening.title: Deafening
advancement.doctor_m.deafening.descripti: Strike the Warden with the Sonic Screwdriver in overcharge mode!
advancement.doctor_m.scan_overload.title: How could this be...
advancement.doctor_m.scan_overload.descr: Scanned an entity that the Sonic Screwdriver finds incomprehensible
advancement.doctor_m.not_a_hallucination: You threw the TARDIS key into lava, and doing so made the TARDIS feel uneasy.
advancements.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.title: Past, Ancient, Dark, Forced to Take Up
advancements.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.descrip: We had forgotten all this—violence, discord, disaster—yet that war compelled us to return to savagery. And now, farewell to time itself.
advancements.doctor_m.vortex_manipulator: Use with care. Don't become the second Major Anderson.
advancements.doctor_m.tlipoca_scythe.des: Now I have become Death, the reaper of souls in this world.
advancements.doctor_m.cross_time_trade.d: Trade with a Type 103 TARDIS merchant.
advancements.doctor_m.marian_trade.title: Alright! Deal!
advancements.doctor_m.tech_next_gen.desc: From the future, or from the past?
tardis.message.control.siege.confirm_pro: Press again to enable Siege Mode! (Wait 10 seconds before clicking)

entity.doctor_m.marian_jin.dialog.stage1: §f[Marian] §r§cWhy are you hitting me! That hurts!
§f[Marian] §r§cUgh... you're bullying me! I'm fighting back!
§f[Marian] §r§cStop! Do you even know who I am?
§f[Marian] §r§cThat's so mean... even my foster mother never hit me!
§f[Marian] §r§cYou're done! I'm going to graffiti all over your timeline!
entity.doctor_m.marian_jin.dialog.stage2: §f[Marian] §r§cI'm really angry now! There will be serious consequences!
§f[Marian] §r§cI'm telling my dad! He'll erase you from history!
§f[Marian] §r§cOw! That hurts! Do you want me to turn you into a frog?!
§f[Marian] §r§cDon't you know how scary I am when I'm mad?
§f[Marian] §r§cHmph! You think I'm afraid to hit you?
entity.doctor_m.marian_jin.dialog.stage3: §f[Marian] §r§cHit me! Hit me! Now you know you were wrong, don't you!
§f[Marian] §r§cYou forced me! I didn't want this!
§f[Marian] §r§cHmph! Got hit, did you? Serves you right!
§f[Marian] §r§cI'll lock you in a time corner and never let you out!
entity.doctor_m.marian_jin.dialog.peacef: §f[Marian] §r§7Heh, want a full subsystem? Or an engine? I've got plenty of Nether Stars too...
§f[Marian] §r§7My stuff is expensive. If you can't afford it, don't touch me.
§f[Marian] §r§7What are you staring at? Buy or leave.
§f[Marian] §r§7I'm in a good mood today, so I'll give you a... uh, 1% off.
§f[Marian] §r§7These are treasures I've gathered from various timelines—you're getting a bargain.
§f[Marian] §r§cI'm very angry right now. I don't want to talk to you!
§f[Marian] §r§cHmph! You hit me just now and now you want to trade? Dream on!
§f[Marian] §r§cGo away! You annoy me just by standing there!
§f[Marian] §r§cMy shop is closed to you today! And tomorrow too!
entity.doctor_m.marian_jin.dialog.hurt.4: §f[Marian] §c§oI'm going to use the De-Mat Gun to turn you into a time ghost!
entity.doctor_m.marian_jin.retaliation.p: §4§o§lYou can't escape! Come here! — Marian rudely yanks you in front of her.
§4§lYou feel reality collapsing around you... your causal chain has been violently disrupted!
entity.doctor_m.marian_jin.retaliation.d: §5§oThe collapsing causal paradox strikes at your very existence...
entity.doctor_m.marian_jin.retaliation.v: §4§l§oMarian: The Time Vortex will teach you some manners.
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.hurt.trader.1: §f[%s] §r§c§oOuch! How much is this going to cost me...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.ceasefire.def: §f[%s] §r§e§oPlease stop! I don't want to be your enemy...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.ceasefire.tim: §f[%s] §r§e§oI-I'm just passing through... please don't hurt me...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.ceasefire.tra: §f[%s] §r§c§oHey! The customer is king, but even a king shouldn't hit a merchant!
§f[%s] §r§c§oStop! If you break my stuff, how can I do business?
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.ceasefire.bra: §f[%s] §r§6§oAre you sure you want to do this?
§f[%s] §r§6§oI'd advise you to think twice—this is not wise.
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.warn.timid.0: §f[%s] §r§cI-I don't want to... but don't push me!
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.warn.timid.1: §f[%s] §r§cP-please stop! I don't want to hurt anyone, but I will defend myself...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.warn.trader.0: §f[%s] §r§cYou should know—the Time Vortex is not a pleasant place!
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.retaliate.ene: §b§o%s fires a beam of light at you!
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.retaliate.hig: §d§o%s flings you high into the air...
§d§o%s sends you flying into the sky!
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.retaliate.vor: §4§l%s throws you into the Time Vortex!
§4§l%s feeds you to the Time Vortex!
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.welcome.0: §f[%s] §r§7What do you want? I've got Zeiton energy, Artron crystals...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.welcome.2: §f[%s] §r§7I've got plenty of good stuff here. Do you have enough energy units?
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.welcome.3: §f[%s] §r§7Welcome! The timeline fluctuations are a bit wild today—getting stock wasn't easy.
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.interact.timi: §e§o%s looks at you nervously, seemingly ready to flee...
§e§o%s shrinks her shoulders and mutters something quietly...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.interact.aggr: §c§o%s narrows her eyes, her hand already on her weapon...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.interact.defe: §7§o%s steps back slightly, maintaining a polite distance.
§7§o%s doesn't come closer, but shows no hostility either.
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.interact.brav: §6§o%s crosses her arms and looks at you with interest.
§6§o%s smiles slightly: "Want to talk? I'm listening."
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.trade.hint.su: §8§o(Subsystems? That depends on luck—not always in stock.)
doctor_m.dialog.common.trade.no_item: §7§oYour hands are empty—what are you going to buy with?
doctor_m.dialog.common.trade.reject: §c§oWhat you're holding won't get you anything here.
doctor_m.dialog.common.trade.hint.sneak: §7§oHold the required amount and §e§lSneak + Right-click§r§7 to confirm the trade.

message.doctor_m.oxygen_charger.cooldown: Oxygen Recharger cooling down... %d seconds remaining...
message.doctor_m.oxygen_charger: §7An oxygen recharger specially designed for space exploration—highly efficient and capable of unlimited oxygen production 👍.*Instantly fills your oxygen tank or spacesuit, with a 10s cooldown after each use.
message.doctor_m.rassilon_key.tooltip.li: §7No Time Lord president has ever obtained the Key of Rassilon except Rassilon himself...
message.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.tooltip.line: Destroy this gun, destroy all its data, and do not let its immense power corrupt your mind...
message.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.detail: §7There is no muzzle flash, no sound when you pull the trigger§r*§7Only a pale flash, followed by an unsettling silence§r*§7Things touched by that light do not die—they simply §ccease to exist§7§r*§7Along with the items they carried, gently erased from the timeline.
message.doctor_m.time_key_resurrection: §bOwner of the Time Key, your authority does not end here. You will not be troubled by something as trivial as death. The Hexad God is still watching over you.
message.doctor_m.time_key.tip: §7A crystal that may have countless origins*Rassilon once possessed it, or perhaps its creator*Now, you have obtained it, and the universe shall bow to you.
message.doctor_m.time_key.detail: §7You hold the scepter of time, and the universe begins to bow before you.§r* *§7Death will rewind and resurrect you, clearing the area within §c35 blocks§7.§r*§7Attacks deal §cpercentage health drain§7; any damage can only scratch off §c15%§7 of your max health.§r*§7Arrows vanish before touching you; heal §c10%§7 max health per second and extinguish flames.§r*§7Gain §cflight§7, immune to fire, suffocation, potions, and sonic damage.
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.tip: §7An old pocket watch, yet its brass casing gleams as if it were freshly cast just yesterday...
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.detail: §8§oIt's just an old watch, forgotten by someone...§r* *§7When you should have fallen, a dry click echoes from the dial.§r*§7By the time you come to your senses, the fatal wound is gone, as if you had merely zoned out for a moment.§r*§7The creatures around you also seem dazed by the strange sound.§r* *§7Unfortunately, the mainspring is too rusted; after each reversal, it takes quite a while before it can tick again.
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.revived: §dYour journey is not yet over. The Hexad God watches you, awaiting where your path will finally lead...
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.cooldown: §7The gears in the dial are still spinning idly...*§8Time until next winding: §c%d min %d s
message.doctor_m.relic_gem: §7As time passes, her power is no longer what it once was, but may she still bless you...
message.doctor_m.relic_gem.detail: §7While equipped, you gain permanent resistance and a life-saving effect upon death.
message.doctor_m.relic_gem.status.cooldo: §bCurrent Level %d/%d §2| Resistance Level %d §c| Cooldown %d min %d sec
message.doctor_m.relic_gem.status.upgrad: §bCurrent Level %d/%d §2| Resistance Level %d §e| Upgrade Cost: %d XP §7(Right-click)
message.doctor_m.relic_gem.not_enough_xp: §cNeed %d experience levels to unlock more power
message.doctor_m.eternal_crystal.desc: §7Once blessed by Him, the divine power has waned over time, but what remains is still enough to make all life tremble in fear.
message.doctor_m.eternal_crystal.detail: §7While equipped, each of your attacks will deal an additional forced 50% damage based on your attack damage. Cooldown: 5 seconds.
message.doctor_m.tlipoca_scythe.tip: §cDeath and evil link the ring of darkness. Life and goodness ring the bell of doom.*I hold the scythe and reap all things. The prosperous land shall eventually return to the void.
message.doctor_m.tlipoca_scythe.detail: §c『The weight of a soul is the price of the harvest』*§7Your attack range is §cextended by 1.5§7 blocks§r*§7Deals §c5x§7 damage to undead, §c1.5x§7 to other creatures§r*§7All attacks have §cforced health drain§7 based on max HP§r*§7When target HP is below §c35%§7 or receives overflow damage, §cexecute instantly§r*§7Execution restores §c60%§7 health and hunger, normal hits restore §c25%§r*§7On execution, enemies within §c5 blocks§7 take §cequal forced damage§7 (ignores armor)§r* *§7Right-click §cSoul Reap§7:§r*§7During charge, you are §cinvincible§7, vision focuses, black mist surrounds you§r*§7Every §c2 seconds§7 gains one stack, up to §c5 stacks§7 (10 seconds)§r*§7On release, slashes with range §c6 blocks§7→§c30 blocks§r*§7Higher stacks = higher damage, cooldown §c5s§7→§c60s§7
message.doctor_m.shield_core.detail: §7A personal shield generator that consumes energy to block 99% of damage for you.
message.tooltip.doctor_m.upgrade: Hold this module in off-hand and the Sonic Screwdriver in main hand, then sneak + right-click to install.
message.tooltip.doctor_m.removed_upgrade: Hold an interaction-mode Sonic Screwdriver in off-hand and the Sonic Screwdriver in main hand, then sneak + right-click to remove.
Increases the Sonic Screwdriver's maximum energy capacity when installed.
message.tooltip.doctor_m.regeneration_mo: Lowers the maximum energy capacity but slowly regenerates energy over time.
message.doctor_m.force_field_shield.deta: §7Hold up the §cForce Field Shield §7to gain basic defense§r*§7Immune to §cmost damage§7 (physical, projectiles, explosions, sonic, etc.)§r*§7Environmental damage (fire, suffocation, void, wither, potions, etc.) reduced by §c90%§r*§7When energy is sufficient, §cForce Field Active§7: incinerates projectiles and pushes away all entities except drops within range§r*§7When energy is depleted, force field shuts down, but §cBasic Defense §7remains active§r*§7Brief cooldown after stopping block.
message.doctor_m.vm.cooled_down: Vortex Manipulator has cooled down and is ready to use again.
message.doctor_m.vm.broken_use_injured: §4Error: Core meltdown. Forced operation has caused injury.
message.doctor_m.vm.overheated_3days: §4Warning: Core meltdown. Vortex Manipulator locked. Forced cooling protocol initiated. Estimated recovery time: 3 days.
message.doctor_m.vm.detail: §7A cheap time-travel device, so fast your stomach can't keep up.§r*§7No protective structure whatsoever; enter the wrong coordinates and... you'll end up like Colonel Anderson, §cstuck in the ceiling§7.§r*§7("BT, I found Anderson... he's... in the ceiling.")§r* *§7Hold an Artron Energy Collector in off-hand, sneak + right-click to refuel.
message.doctor_m.vm.time_sickness: §4Warning: The time stream has torn your physiology. Unprotected jump sequelae active, expected to last %d seconds.
message.doctor_m.vm.out_of_bounds: §cTarget coordinates exceed safe boundaries. System safety lock engaged.
message.doctor_m.vm.distance_too_far: §cEstimated fuel cost: %d — exceeds device limit. System safety lock engaged.
message.doctor_m.stch.description: Maybe you need a better set of bones to wield this?
message.doctor_m.stcs.stc_07h_detail: §7STC-08A Support Type — heavier, slower, but strong in defense and damage.
message.doctor_m.stcs.stc_08a_detail: §7STCS series standard model STC-08A — well-balanced in all aspects, widely used as the base platform for STC-09L and STC-07H. Highly rated.
message.doctor_m.stcs.stc_09l_detail: §7STC-08A Assault Type — lightweight without sacrificing power. Remember: Focus. Plan. Strike.
message.doctor_m.stcs.core_low_energy: Insufficient energy to maintain the blade core. At least 800 energy required.
message.doctor_m.tracer.tooltip: §7A detector extremely sensitive to disturbances from every fragment of the Time Key.
message.doctor_m.tracer.detail: §7When held, it responds with subtle pulses to nearby dropped fragments.*Right-click to perform a directional scan, penetrating containers and strata, precisely measuring the distance between you and any fragment.*When inserted into the Sonic Port, the telepathic interface on the console will be replaced with a tracker for ancient ruins or Time Key fragments.
message.doctor_m.toymaker_hammer.tip: §7No rift. No fire. The moment the hammer falls, the TARDIS is split apart by some kind of law—*§cone remains in place, while the other is cast aside and lands steadily.
message.doctor_m.toymaker_hammer.detail: §7Aim it at the TARDIS's §cexterior§7, hold right-click to §ccharge for 2 seconds§7—you'll feel an ancient power responding to you.§r*§7The moment you release, the TARDIS before you is split by some §claw§7: one stays put, the other is §cthrown aside§7 and lands safely.§r*§7Both TARDISes are §cidentical§7—down to every chair and every scratch inside.
message.doctor_m.underwater_oxygen_gener: Generator out of water. Add water with a bucket.
Cannot fill oxygen for this item.

§7An oxygen generator, originally designed for underwater environments, producing oxygen through electrolysis of water (H2O).*Underwater, it supplies oxygen within a certain radius; outside of water, it can be manually refilled with water to generate oxygen.
